solutions.title: Repeated pair merging
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly scan for any overlapping pair, merge it, and restart until stable.

timeComplexity.explanation: There can be O(n) merge rounds and each round can compare O(n^2) interval pairs.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A mutable list of intervals stores the working set.

solutions.title: Sort and merge in one pass
solutions.strategy: Sort intervals by start, then extend the previous merged interval when ranges overlap.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting dominates; the merge pass is linear.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The merged output can contain all intervals.
